Buddhist, writer, animal rights activist and builder.
I meditate, write about animal liberation and mindfulness, and build free tools for practitioners and activists. I'm currently facing felony charges for rescuin
Ridglan has shut down. Now the campaign to free the 16,000 beagles at Marshall BioResources.
Dharma talks from across the Buddhist traditions, transcribed so you can read along, search, and return to what was said.
Meditate with a buddy every week. Get matched with one partner and a fixed time, and keep each other showing up.
A commitment tracker for keeping the promises we make to ourselves: put something at stake, keep the streak, choose the next rung.
A tabletop adventure run by an AI dungeon master. Friends join from their phones; the story, art and narration play on the big screen.
Essays on animal liberation and mindfulness, to read or listen to.

items.text: Get personalized meditation guidance on a donation basis.
Have you been looking for one-on-one guidance for meditation? If so, then read on.
If you consider yourself a complete beginner/relatively new to meditation, then I can offer you guidance. Please note that I am relatively new to teaching so my
I have been meditating for almost three years now and I have done several silent meditation retreats. My shortest retreat was four days and my longest was three
Most recently, I was a monk for three months in Malaysia. I practiced there in the Theravada Buddhist tradition. You can read more about my time as a monk in
I feel comfortable explaining several topics from Buddhist meditation practice, including (but not limited to) the following:
Please note I primarily have learned from a Theravada/Early Buddhist perspective so I am not able to speak much about Mahayana Buddhist practices.
I aim to follow the approach of Motivational Interviewing, where I see myself less as a teacher who leads from the front, and more as a spiritual friend who wal
As is traditional by Buddhist meditation teachers, I offer these teachings free of charge. After a session, if possible, please consider offering a donation of
Sessions will be for 50 minutes and will usually take place online via Zoom. If you are based in NYC, please let me know if you would be interested in in-person
If we are meeting for the first time, the session will primarily be focused on getting to know one another and setting shared goals.
In follow-up sessions, we'll explore how your practice has developed since we last met and address any challenges or insights that have arisen. These sessions a
Furthermore, between sessions, I may suggest some practice goals, such as a certain number of meditation minutes or relevant readings.
My schedule is quite open, so feel free to
find a time that works for you on my calendar
If you are not yet ready to schedule but simply have questions,
send me a message through the contact page
If you have any feedback for me,
send it through the contact page
I look forward to meeting with you :)

Feel free to reach out for any questions, collaborations, or just to say hello. This is my personal address.

I typically respond within 24-48 hours. For urgent matters, please mention it in your subject line.

I value all feedback! Constructive, positive, or just general thoughts.

I spend my time on two things: fighting for animals and helping people build a steady mindfulness practice. The servers are cheap and the campaign costs are cov
Monthly support helps most, because I can plan around it. Cancel anytime.
About a coffee a month. Ten of these cover all the hosting.
Add $0.46 to cover card fees, so the full $5 reaches me
This is personal support for my independent work, not a charitable donation, so it isn't tax-deductible. Thank you for backing it.
I take part in open rescue and public campaigns to get animals out of laboratories and breeding facilities, and I have faced criminal charges for it.
I helped free the beagles kept for experimentation at Ridglan Farms in Wisconsin. Ridglan has since shut down.
The campaign I am working on now: freeing the roughly 16,000 beagles bred for laboratories at Marshall BioResources.
I work on programs and tools that help people start a practice and keep it.
A semester-long residential program for young adults built around meditation, study and community. I serve as Operations Lead.
Mindfulness retreats and programs for teens and young adults that I work with.
Meditate with a buddy at a fixed weekly time, so the practice sticks.
Search across thousands of Dhamma talks, transcribed so you can find the teaching you need.
Thank you. May your generosity come back to you many times over.
May all beings be happy, healthy, and safe.
